newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Transaero to announce tender results in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Russia Transaero to announce tender results in Feb.

text.p: Russian airline AO Transaero will announce in February the results of a tender to buy or lease aircraft for part of a major expansion, the president of the company said on Wednesday.
Alexander Pleshakov told Reuters that the airline "had already made its choice of aircraft for the fleet".
"We will officially announce it in February," Pleshakov said.
He gave no details of the size, make or quantity of planes in the tender.
The company said earlier that Boeing Co, McDonnel Douglas Corp and Russia's Ilyushin Aviation Corp were among those taking part in the tender.

Transaero launched the tender for new Russian and/or Western-made planes in May, saying it planned a $1.2 billion aircraft acquisition programme which would increase its fleet to at least 40 aircraft by 2000.
It currently flies 14 planes, including five Boeing 757s, five Boeing 737s, one wide-body Ilyushin-86 and three McDonnel Douglas DC-10-30s.
Transaero has said it would rely on its own funds as well as financing from Russian and Western banks to buy or lease the planes.
